rationale: The plan correctly treats the STAR/featureCounts matrix as raw integer gene counts fed directly to DESeqDataSetFromMatrix (explicitly no tximport, no length offset), with a minimal justified filter (>=10 in >=3, the smallest group), explicit reference level and contrast, Wald test, apeglm shrinkage, BH at 0.05 with independent filtering, and a clearly stated n=3/group power caveat. QC is complete and design-specific (blind VST PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, colored by condition, single batch noted, outlier flag-don't-drop policy). Normalization is only implied: the plan never names size factors or median-of-ratios for DESeq2, and the edgeR arm lists estimateDisp/glmQLFit without calcNormFactors, so TMM is not stated. Enrichment was not requested; it is added but done properly (full ranked list on Wald stat, tested-gene universe, 15-500 window, named Hallmark 2026.1), though the Reactome version is only 'current'. The report specification covers method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, and caveats.
